lessons.title: Practice Chained Comparisons
lessons.description: Python allows chaining comparisons like min_val <= x <= max_val. Write in_range(x, low, high). The test checks that in_range(5, 1, 10) is true; in_range(1, 1, 10) is true; in_range(0, 1, 10) is false.
learning_objectives: This step keeps the score only when it sits between the two bounds, using score and 7.
lessons.solution_code:
def in_range(x, low, high):
    return low <= x <= high
